title: The front matter of one spec file

id.description: Matches the file name without its extension. The numeric prefix is the default order.

depends_on.description: Spec ids that must be merged first. Empty for a spec that can start from the base branch.

user_visible.description: True when, once this spec merges, a person can try something new: a typed flag, an opt-in setting, a changed default, or a screen, message or document they can reach, even when what is behind it is off by default. False for a helper nothing calls yet, plumbing, or a surface whose way in comes from a later spec. A true spec waits for manual testing before it merges.

reviewers.description: Lenses for this spec beyond the configured default set. A lens named here with a leading minus is removed from the default set for this spec.
